title: Softener Hardness Breakthrough Alert
app: Flo by Moen, Rachio, Flume, Maytronics Dolphin, pool sensors, water softener sensors, and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watersoftener:status
| stats latest(outlet_hardness_gpg) as outlet_hardness_gpg by unit
| where outlet_hardness_gpg>1
| sort - outlet_hardness_gpg
description: Uses Water-softener outlet readings telemetry to monitor hardness detected after water passes the softener in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for media or salt issues that are reducing treatment quality, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Water-softener outlet readings data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It builds hardness detected after water passes the softener so you can spot media or salt issues that are reducing treatment quality before it becomes annoying.
